sources.title: Current owner direction: hosted execution and no licence procurement
sources.scope_note: Integrate the prediction-market recommendations into this blueprint; Netcup/Oracle are the intended compute environment. No procurement or live financial action is requested. This does not establish provider permission or operator eligibility.

sources.title: Kalshi market-data quick start
sources.scope_note: Public unauthenticated REST metadata/order-book access and current endpoint shape. Technical availability is distinct from data-use terms; authentication and limits must be checked for the exact interface.

sources.title: Kalshi order-book response semantics
sources.scope_note: YES/NO bid ladders, complementary asks, fixed-point price and quantity strings. Executable price is not last trade or midpoint.

sources.title: Kalshi historical data and cutoff partition
sources.scope_note: Separate live/historical data boundaries and historical endpoints. The adapter must reconcile cutoffs and pagination; candles do not establish historical order queue position.

sources.title: Kalshi fee rounding
sources.scope_note: Fee rounding depends on balance precision and accumulation rules. Pin the applicable fee formula, series settings and effective time separately; synthetic examples in this pack are not a quote of current fees.

sources.title: Kalshi WebSocket order-book updates
sources.scope_note: Authenticated snapshot/update stream and sequence-bearing book observations. Reconstruct only with a valid snapshot and coherent update stream.

sources.title: Polymarket market-resolution rules
sources.scope_note: Settlement depends on exact predefined market rules and a resolution/dispute process. Similar titles do not prove economically complementary contracts.

sources.title: Kalshi and the Rise of Macro Markets
sources.scope_note: Federal Reserve FEDS2026-010, Diercks, Katz and Wright. Evaluates macroeconomic market-implied expectations. Forecasting evidence motivates replication, not a claim of VAN profits.

sources.title: Do Prediction Markets Forecast Cryptocurrency Volatility?
sources.scope_note: Mohanty and Krishnamachari, 2026. Reports conditional and mixed out-of-sample results for Kalshi macro signals and cryptocurrency volatility; not an independently replicated VAN trading result.

sources.title: Unravelling the Probabilistic Forest: Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
sources.scope_note: AFT2025 study of Polymarket inconsistencies and measured arbitrage activity. It does not establish accessible Kalshi–Polymarket arbitrage for this owner.

sources.title: Risk-Constrained Kelly Gambling
sources.scope_note: Formal growth/drawdown trade-offs under modeled assumptions. No model-confidence output becomes an automatic Kelly allocation or overrides VAN risk limits.

sources.title: Kalshi calibration research
sources.scope_note: Exchange-produced aggregate calibration evidence. Event categories, participation and timing require separate evaluation; aggregate accuracy is not an early tradable edge.

sources.title: The economics of Kalshi prediction market
sources.scope_note: Author summary of research including favourite–longshot bias and maker/taker differences. Supports subgroup calibration and execution-aware rather than universal probability claims.

sources.title: Kalshi Developer Agreement
sources.scope_note: Ordinary API use is contractually scoped; public access is not unrestricted downstream reuse. Licence procurement is outside this phase. Actual source-use scope remains a recorded operational fact, not assumed by hosting.

sources.title: Kalshi Member Agreement
sources.scope_note: Eligibility is not determined solely by server address. The agreement distinguishes event-contract trading from non-trading access. No eligibility conclusion, registration or live activation is issued by this pack.

sources.title: Global DIAL gateway observation during Rev1.1 preparation
sources.scope_note: Serving gateway and authenticated owner route observed. Other broad projections included stale/readiness limitations. No prediction-market worker, region, account, financial action or model performance was qualified.
